card.name: Zero in AUC time ranges
card.fires_on: The digit 0 written as the start of the AUC subscript range, right after "AUC" and before "-24", "-inf", "-t" or "to 24", in drug interaction pharmacokinetics text.

modes.label: AUC start time
modes.description: The starting 0 of an AUC interval such as 0-24 or 0-inf.
